meta.notes: An armour piece names this asset in its equipment_asset field, and the game draws these layers on whoever wears it. humanoid covers the helmet, chestplate and boots; humanoid_leggings covers the leggings. Each texture id names textures/entity/equipment/<layer>/ruby_armour.png in this namespace; the placeholders here are small, so draw the real 64 by 32 armour textures over them.
